why: Records are the real package.json files installed under node_modules, sampled by a fixed stride in path order. Questions are derived from their descriptions by rule: verbatim, every third long word removed, near duplicates that share three or more long words, and descriptions of real packages left out of the store. No sentence here was written for this corpus.
